purpose: Launchpad swap router on Base Sepolia (web app doc §4.6zp option A, §4.6zq; contracts doc §34): one exact-input swap in one Uniswap V4 pool, paid by the caller and paid out to the caller. A sale is a plain ERC-20 approve of the router once per token, then the swap (2 transactions the first time, 1 after, no Permit2 signature; EIP-7702 accounts included). Tokens are pulled only from msg.sender, only the amount the swap used, inside the router's own unlock, straight to the PoolManager; unused ETH is refunded. No owner, no admin, no upgrade, no storage, no arbitrary calls.
